Hi Elena — thanks for the PO and the heads up. Short answers up front: yes, we can send emailed PDF invoices; portal enrollment is optional (we offer the Redwood Billing Portal as an alternative for AP teams that want a central place to pull history).

A couple of details so we set this up right:
- If you choose email-only delivery we will: send PDF invoices to the address you confirm, include PO number on the PDF and filename, and add VAT number on the invoice lines where applicable.
- Portal opt-out tradeoffs: you won't get the self-serve invoice history or automated webhook notifications; invoices will be sent as attachments only and acknowledgements will be manual.
- We need the AP contact name, email, and any remittance instructions (bank details for SEPA/ACH) you prefer recorded on our side.

I've attached our AP enrollment form to this thread (BrightLane_AP_Form.pdf) — filling that speeds setup but isn't strictly required. If you'd rather, provide the AP contact + remit details in-line and we'll update your account.

Would you like us to:
1) Keep portal disabled and route PDFs to invoices@brightlane.com (and cc accounting@brightlane.com if you want), or
2) Enable portal and send invites to a billing contact (one-time setup)?

If option 1, confirm the exact invoice-to address(es) and the VAT number you'd like printed.

Thanks,
